title: Tech Note: Image Pixelizer
author: Kristopher Merolla, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: DOM Export to VAR / DOM CLOSE

historical_commentary.text: This is a clever workaround note that leans on the 4D Web Area to run JavaScript (for canvas-based pixel averaging) and SVG rectangle drawing because native 4D commands couldn't do this directly at the time — the technique itself still works today, but 4D has since added its own image-manipulation and picture-handling capabilities that may make some of this Web-Area/JS/SVG round-tripping unnecessary for simpler cases. The Web Area, DOM Export to VAR, and BLOB TO PICTURE commands used are all still current.
related_updates: Web Area and DOM Export to VAR remain current commands
4D has since expanded native picture/image manipulation commands, potentially reducing need for this JS/SVG workaround for some use cases
SVG drawing commands and Base64 handling remain valid in current 4D
